Por que o agente se superestima: avaliad: Why the agent overrates itself: a separate, skeptical evaluator
O agente que fez o trabalho é o pior jui: The agent that did the work is the worst judge of it: it writes "3 passed" without having run anything, or it finds the defect and talks itself into approving. In this lesson you separate the one who does from the one who checks: an evaluator that doesn't read the agent's report, runs the test on its own, and starts from the assumption that it's broken.
separar quem faz de quem confere: rodar: separate the one who does from the one who checks: run an evaluator that doesn't read the agent's report, runs the test, and rejects what only looks done.

Quem faz não confere: The one who does doesn't check
Clique em cada bloco. O relato do agente: Tap each block. The agent's report is left out on purpose.
Escreve código e, no fim, um relato: \"P: Writes code and, at the end, a report: "Done, 3 passed". That report is the least trustworthy part of the whole job: the agent may not have run anything, may have run it and misread it, or may have touched the test.
O avaliador não recebe o relato. Se rece: The evaluator doesn't get the report. If it did, it would anchor on it. What goes in the package is what can be checked: the diff, the new files, and the output of a test the evaluator ran itself.
diff + teste rodado por fora: diff + test run from the outside
O avaliar.sh do kit roda o teste ele mes: The kit's avaliar.sh runs the test itself and builds the package. The test rules: an exit code other than 0 fails before any opinion.
Outra sessão (ou outro modelo), sem ferr: Another session (or another model), with no tools, with a prompt that says to start from "it's broken" and reject when in doubt. If it thinks the test itself is wrong, it rejects and writes DEFEITO NO VERIFICADOR instead of approving.
Primeira linha VEREDITO: APROVADO ou REP: First line VEREDITO: APROVADO or REPROVADO, then the reasons with the snippet that proves them. The script only exits with 0 if the test passed AND the evaluator approved.
Reprovado: o motivo volta ao agente como: Rejected: the reason goes back to the agent as the next task
Concordância entre dois modelos não é pr: Agreement between two models is not proof. What closes the cycle is the test, the acceptance criterion and, when a mistake is costly, a person.
O que já se mediu sobre o agente se aval: What has already been measured about agents grading themselves
Três fatos, com fonte. Nenhum deles é op: Three facts, with sources. None of them is opinion.
No artigo de harness para apps de longa: In the harness article for long-running apps, Anthropic reports that an agent evaluating its own work tends to praise mediocre work. The fix was to separate generator and evaluator.
O avaliador \"de fábrica\" também era fr: The "out-of-the-box" evaluator was weak too: it found defects and then convinced itself they weren't serious, and it tested only on the surface.
Afina-se lendo o log: You tune it by reading the log
O avaliador melhorou depois de várias ro: The evaluator improved after several rounds of reading its logs and adjusting the prompt wherever its judgment diverged from a person's. Even so, bugs remained in nested features.
Lição para você: o prompt cético é ponto: Lesson for you: the skeptical prompt is a starting point. Calibration against your own labels comes in lesson 6.
Dois modelos concordando que \"está cert: Two models agreeing that "it's correct" is one opinion repeated. What closes the cycle is the test, the acceptance criterion, and human sign-off.
